provenance: The unapproved half of the Cedar Creek Effluent Pump Station (source key PH_3) dictionary. export_dictionary_review puts these under "pending", which apply_dictionary_review does not read, so replaying only the approvals would land a deployment with these points bare and looking unreviewed. Each entry here carries the reason already recorded against the point locally.
policy: Withholding records a decision; it binds nothing and changes no reading. Apply this after the approvals pack so a point that is meant to be approved is never left holding only a reason.

withhold.reason: Reproduced at a second station: Saraswati PH recorded ~1048 A with the motor off, and Parvathi peaks at 1049 A with every bay stopped for ten days. A systematic offset, not a unit question.
Saraswati PH showed this reading 0 on a pump loaded to 24.5 MW, so the tag is not wired to a live CT. Parvathi was stopped all window and also reads 0, which cannot clear that finding.
Saraswati PH observed 55.3, which fits neither V nor kV for an 11 kV bus. Parvathi reads a flat 0 even for bus voltage, so the tag appears unscanned here and cannot clear it.
Reads 0 under load at Saraswati PH, and the catalogue proposes no unit. Parvathi was stopped all window, so its 0 adds nothing.
Source data type is unknown, so the reading cannot be trusted as a number. Unchanged from the Saraswati PH finding.

Station total discharge: the exact sum of the per-bay dv in 2,279 of 2,279 sampled snapshots. Left unmapped on purpose - the catalogue parameter for discharge rate belongs to a pump discharge line, and this is a plant-wide sum rather than a line measurement, so filing it there would record something untrue about the plant. It carries the same unresolved unit as the per-bay tags it sums.
